# Support

ScanFit is an unpaid, unpublished alpha without guaranteed support or response times.

- Ask integration and usage questions in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Ahmedsultan09/scanfit/discussions).
- Report reproducible defects with the bug report form.
- Propose scoped product changes with the feature request form.
- Report security and privacy vulnerabilities through the private process in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Use synthetic or fully redacted documents in every public post. Do not upload personal paperwork to an issue or discussion.
